The legal issues identified in the paragraph revolve around property law, specifically the conflict between a property owner's right to exclusive possession and the doctrine of adverse possession. The case-specific questions presented are: 1) Whether the long-standing fence constitutes an encroachment that violates the new homeowner's property rights, and 2) Whether the fence's existence over a statutory period allows the neighbor to claim title to the encroached land through adverse possession, thereby mitigating the homeowner's demand for removal.
